races.name: Mercedes-Benz Of Chichester Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
ROYAL RHYTHM had plenty to spare at Worcester and a 9 lb rise may not stop him if able to string 2 decent efforts together. Jefe Triunfo could pose a threat if recapturing the form he showed in these refitted cheekpieces last autumn, while Clever Relation may benefit from the longer trip.

  1. ROYAL RHYTHM (IRE)
  2. JEFE TRIUNFO (FR)
  3. CLEVER RELATION

races.name: KSR Lighting Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MOAB is fit from a good run on the Flat and perhaps this can finally be his day over hurdles. Downtown Nashville has shown enough in a couple of bumpers this summer to make him of interest in a race like this now hurdling. Anzac Day also has the potential to leave the form of his first run over hurdles behind.

  1. MOAB (IRE)
  2. DOWNTOWN NASHVILLE (IRE)
  3. ANZAC DAY (IRE)

races.name: KEP Communications Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
GATA BAN won over this C&D in June and ran respectably in a stronger race at Worcester last time, so she is entitled to come on for that recent effort and makes plenty of appeal in a race in which most of her rivals have question marks over them. Unspeakable has had a breathing operation and is 3 lb below his last winning mark, so must be respected, while Of Corse I Can won over this C&D in October from a higher mark but needs to bounce back from some below-par efforts.

  1. GATA BAN (IRE)
  2. UNSPEAKABLE (IRE)
  3. OF CORSE I CAN (FR)

races.name: David And Carol Pugh Memorial Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
NO MORE BOLERO sometimes takes some stoking but can quickly resume winning ways in what looks a weaker race than he contested last time. Handicap debutant So Proud can step up again and rates the biggest danger to the selection.

  1. NO MORE BOLERO
  2. SO PROUD (IRE)
  3. ASK A SAINTE

races.name: Bison Events Ltd Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MIDNIGHT JEWEL boasts an excellent course record and has twice won this race in the past, so he is taken to land a fifth course success on the back of two pipe-openers over hurdles. Jiair Madrik has won 3 consecutive chases this season and rates the chief danger despite a 17 lb rise in the handicap.

  1. MIDNIGHT JEWEL
  2. JIAIR MADRIK (FR)
  3. MARTIN'S DENUO (FR)

races.name: KSR Lighting, The Ultimate Lighting Solutions Mares' Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
DELULU made a promising debut and can get off the mark at the second attempt. Lady Chauntee is an interesting sort on paper and can chase the selection home, while Silver Whisper may prove best of the rest.

  1. DELULU
  2. LADY CHAUNTEE
  3. SILVER WHISPER

races.name: Irish Thoroughbred Marketing 'Confined' EBF Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Plenty of depth to this maiden with IZUBA just about the most persuasive option having finished ahead of a next-time-out winner when a promising second over 6f at Ascot in July. Ghost Raider won't mind any ease in the ground if taking after his dam and he's a big danger, while the Fahey team took this a year ago and Scenic Route rates another likely improver.

  1. IZUBA (IRE)
  2. GHOST RAIDER (IRE)
  3. SCENIC ROUTE (IRE)

races.name: Fine Details Car Valeting Sprint Handicap
races.verdict:
EXPLOSIVE FINNISH arrives on an upward curve and is taken to defy a 6 lb rise for his course success in July. Managing Director has progressed with each run since returning from a long layoff and rates the chief danger despite his high draw, while Havana Rum and Call To Action are both on workable marks and look best of the rest.

  1. EXPLOSIVE FINNISH
  2. MANAGING DIRECTOR (IRE)
  3. HAVANA RUM (IRE)

races.name: Hanson Springs Stayers Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
HIGH FIBRE can continue his excellent start for the James Owen yard and complete a cross-code hat-trick. Marbuzet escapes a penalty for last Sunday's Beverley apprentice race success and is second choice ahead of Trojan Sun. Florida Dreams is also capable of having a say if behaving better in the preliminaries this time.

  1. HIGH FIBRE (IRE)
  2. MARBUZET
  3. TROJAN SUN

races.name: Saltmoore Collection Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
BESIEGED very much has the profile of one who should have more to offer in handicaps so he gets the vote. Fellow 3-y-o Stoneacre Donny must have been amiss here last time as his handicap record prior to that was solid and he can bounce back and provide the chief threat ahead of C&D specialists Castle Stuart and Dark Moon Rising.

  1. BESIEGED
  2. STONEACRE DONNY
  3. CASTLE STUART (IRE)

races.name: Starman At Tally Ho Stud Garrowby Stakes (Listed)
races.verdict:
DOUBLE RUSH drops into Listed company after underperforming in the July Cup, but he is better judged on his handicap hat-trick earlier in the season when he looked a stakes winner in waiting, and this looks a good opportunity for him to get back to winning ways. Spycatcher hasn’t been able to show his true form in 2 outings this year but is a classy sort on his day and will appreciate any rain, while America Queen arrives on an upward curve.

  1. DOUBLE RUSH (IRE)
  2. SPYCATCHER (IRE)
  3. AMERICA QUEEN (IRE)

races.name: Eboracum Security Handicap
races.verdict:
A typically competitive handicap for the course and the unexposed MR NOBLE, who has run well here before, gets the verdict. Power Fizz is fancied to bounce back from a couple of disappointing efforts ahead of He's A Monster. Northern Express and Woohoo are others to consider.

  1. MR NOBLE (IRE)
  2. POWER FIZZ (IRE)
  3. HE'S A MONSTER (IRE)

races.name: Coopers Marquees Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
INSPIRED arrives in great form and can follow up his Goodwood success last week under a penalty. Alpha Capture has been a model of consistency this season and should be thereabouts again, while the 3-y-o Substance can't be ruled out on just his third start for current yard. Of the rest, Callisto Dream and Lir Speciale can't be completely ruled out.

  1. INSPIRED (IRE)
  2. ALPHA CAPTURE (IRE)
  3. SUBSTANCE (IRE)

races.name: Hollywoodbets Durbanville Welcomes You Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
KING OF FATE just about appeals most in this field having stepped up on his debut run at Kenilworth latst time. The Big Bang is another who could play a big role in proceedings, while Le Soleil is a candidate for the three.

  1. KING OF FATE (SAF)
  2. THE BIG BANG (SAF)
  3. LE SOLEIL (SAF)

races.name: Join The Race Coast Turf Club Maiden Plate
races.verdict:
GUNNER GALACTICO has a healthy advantage formwise and tops the shortlist . Saratoga Sunrise is the rational second choice, while Tequila Tango comes into calculations for minor honours.

  1. GUNNER GALACTICO (SAF)
  2. SARATOGA SUNRISE (SAF)
  3. TEQUILA TANGO (SAF)

races.name: Bet With The Tote www.tote.co.za Maiden Plate (F & M)
races.verdict:
VERSE FOR SUZANNE has an outstanding chance on form and is going to be hard to beat. What The Fluff is hard to ignore if looking elsewhere, while Desert Ice is another who could figure.

  1. VERSE FOR SUZANNE (SAF)
  2. WHAT THE FLUFF (SAF)
  3. DESERT ICE (SAF)

races.name: Lucky Fish New Fortune B Stakes
races.verdict:
MENTE ET MANU won 3 times in 2025 and has been knocking on the door of late, so he could be the way to go. Marcus Aurelius makes most appeal of the others, while It Is My Time is one to bear in mind as well.

  1. MENTE ET MANU (SAF)
  2. MARCUS AURELIUS (SAF)
  3. IT IS MY TIME (SAF)

races.name: Race Coast Incentives Powered By Hollywoodbets D Stakes
races.verdict:
PACIFIC WATERS looks a fairly solid proposition at this level so there's little desire to look elsewhere. Black Path makes most appeal among the others, while Typically French also looks good for a place.

  1. PACIFIC WATERS (SAF)
  2. BLACK PATH (SAF)
  3. TYPICALLY FRENCH (SAF)

races.name: Genuine Ennion Syndicate Class 4 (F & M)
races.verdict:
HAMPSTEAD HEATH has put together a solid series of efforts lately and just about gets the nod in this field. Gin Palace seems the principal threat, while Odds And Evens also seems unlikely to be far away.

  1. HAMPSTEAD HEATH (SAF)
  2. GIN PALACE (SAF)
  3. ODDS AND EVENS (SAF)

races.name: Lucky Fish Turf Luck D Stakes
races.verdict:
LOUI'S STAR looks to have narrowly the best credentials so is awrded the tentative vote. Phantom Man seems the leading danger, while Etoilefillante also commands a closer look.

  1. LOUI'S STAR (SAF)
  2. PHANTOM MAN (SAF)
  3. ETOILEFILLANTE (SAF)

races.name: Gallop Form Class 4 (F & M)
races.verdict:
FOG IN FINLAND formwise has little to fear here in receiot of weight all round so she looks the answer. Lark's Song will probably give the selection most to think about, while Star World can fight it out for minor honours.

  1. FOG IN FINLAND (SAF)
  2. LARK'S SONG (SAF)
  3. STAR WORLD (SAF)

races.name: Hollywoodbets Bright Future Class 3
races.verdict:
BLACK CHEETAH looks to be the safest option on the back of an excellent second at Kenilworth. Witch Hazel looks the best back-up if the selection underperforms, while World Series also demands a closer look.

  1. BLACK CHEETAH (SAF)
  2. WITCH HAZEL (SAF)
  3. WORLD SERIES (SAF)
